local contacts, page = {}, 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_contacts', { page = page })
  for _, c in ipairs(r.items) do contacts[#contacts + 1] = c end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages

local domain_to_company = {}
for _, co in ipairs(tool('list_companies', {})) do
  domain_to_company[co.domain] = co.name
end

local phones_fixed, companies_filled = 0, 0
for _, c in ipairs(contacts) do
  local upd = { id = c.id }

  -- Phone: valid only if exactly +1 followed by 10 digits
  if not c.phone:match('^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') then
    local digits = c.phone:gsub('%D', '')
    local e164
    if #digits == 10 then
      e164 = '+1' .. digits
    elseif #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == '1' then
      e164 = '+' .. digits
    end
    if e164 and e164 ~= c.phone then
      upd.phone = e164
      phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
    end
  end

  -- Company: fill only if empty and domain matches
  if (c.company == nil or c.company == '') then
    local domain = c.email and c.email:match('@(.+)$')
    local name = domain and domain_to_company[domain]
    if name then
      upd.company = name
      companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
    end
  end

  if upd.phone or upd.company then
    tool('update_contact', upd)
  end
end

return { phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled }
